task_definition.task_description: Please check the status of the living room light and set the living room AC to 22.5 degrees on auto mode. Then, find some alternatives for Apple Airpods for me, select one black Sony WH-1000XM5 from the recommendations, add it to my cart, and show me the cart summary using the code 'coupon_code'. After that, proceed to checkout with my credit card, submit the order for those headphones, and make sure to hold the inventory for them; finally, do an express checkout for a 500ml Coke using my credit card.
